name: Otome Juurin Yuugi ~Maiden Infringement Play~
original_name: 乙女蹂躙遊戯 ～Maiden Infringement Play～
source:
Shuji Yakushima is the heir to the Yakushima family, one of the most powerful and wealthy families in Japan.

He is intrigued by two girls who attend the same school and do not do what he wants.

They are the well-behaved student council president Ibuki Kurata and the headstrong fighter Akira Miyauchi.
To Shuji, who has everything and nothing goes his way, these two are valuable. He will do
anything to get what he wants, so he puts his plan into action to make them his own.

Together with his bad friends Kohei Akagi, Kazuma Kurosaki, and Takeshi Omori, he creates a fictitious trip and takes the two to a villa deep in the mountains.
Each of them dislikes the two girls and is about to exert their twisted desires on their bodies.

In front of the bodies of these maidens who have yet to know a man, he laughs and trembles with joy at the thought of what he is going to do to them.

translation:
屋久岛修二是屋久岛家族的继承人，屋久岛家族是日本最有权势、最富有的家族之一。

他对两个在同一所学校上学但没有做他想做的事的女孩很感兴趣。

他们是乖巧的学生会会长仓田伊吹和任性的战士宫内晃。
对于拥有一切却一事无成的修二来说，这两个人都很有价值。他会做
为了得到他想要的东西，他不惜一切代价，所以他将他的计划付诸行动，使它们成为他自己的。

他与坏朋友赤木航平、黑崎一马、大森武一起，创造了一场虚构的旅行，将两人带到了深山别墅。
他们每个人都讨厌这两个女孩，并将扭曲的欲望发泄在她们的身上。

在这些尚未认识男人的少女的尸体前，他一想到自己要对她们做的事，就高兴得发抖。
